title: Fooling the LVLM Judges: Visual Biases in LVLM-Based Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and benchmarking visual biases (such as image manipulations and overlays) in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) used as judges for text-to-image alignment. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical frameworks, though it briefly mentions ethical concerns regarding the reinforcement of aesthetic biases.
